gates.requiredScope: Bind branch, run ID, accepted intake/review/manifest hashes, scope, authority, ten stable gates, no-secret boundary and no-follow-up boundary before any implementation edit.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '$state = Get-Content specs/006-embeddable-vm-nuget/autonomous-run-state.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; foreach ($item in $state.acceptedArtifacts) { $actual = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $item.path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); if ($actual -ne $item.sha256) { throw "Accepted artifact drift: $($item.path)" } }; Write-Output "PASS accepted-artifact hashes"'
gates.rationale: Drift in accepted inputs, authority or scope invalidates every later implementation and delivery claim.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Start or resume of every phase; any accepted-artifact, intake-series, authority, branch, run-state or stable-gate change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove that Run and Step use one execution kernel and return equal reason, count, state, diagnostics and I/O for normal, error, cancellation and terminal-idempotence cases while preserving existing callers.
exactCommands: dotnet test TinyPl0.sln --configuration Release --no-build --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --logger "trx;LogFileName=regression.trx" --results-directory artifacts/test-results/regression
gates.rationale: One dispatcher prevents semantic drift, while observable parity and compatibility tests prove the public contract.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any VM dispatch, option, result, state, diagnostic, cancellation, I/O, opcode, OPR or public-signature change.

gates.requiredScope: Prove fixed validation precedence, all positive and negative stack/budget/program/P-Code boundaries, exact dispatch counting, cancellation precedence and no N+1 side effect or prevalidation allocation.
exactCommands: dotnet test tests/Pl0.Tests/Pl0.Tests.csproj --configuration Release --no-build --filter "FullyQualifiedName~VmExecutionKernelCoverageTests" --collect:"XPlat Code Coverage" --results-directory artifacts/test-results/resource-coverage
gates.rationale: Host-provided options and P-Code cross a trust boundary and must fail deterministically before unsafe resource use or side effects.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any bound, default, validation order, allocation, counting point, terminal-state, P-Code rule or I/O-boundary change.

gates.requiredScope: Restore with locks, pack Core and VM at one Release Please SemVer, inspect package and symbol inventories, verify metadata/README/XML/SourceLink and enforce the exact VM-to-Core dependency with no extra runtime dependency.
gates.rationale: A solution build does not prove the immutable public package pair, exact dependency graph or consumable package contents.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any props, csproj, PackageReference, ProjectReference, package metadata, README, XML documentation, symbol, SourceLink, lockfile, version or pack change.

gates.requiredScope: Before merge, restore equal Core and VM package versions from the newly packed local feed into a clean net10.0 consumer without ProjectReference; after release, repeat from NuGet.org and prove compile, Run and Step behavior on all three supported operating systems.
gates.rationale: Only an independent empty-cache public restore demonstrates real package delivery and cross-platform host usability.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any package version/content/dependency, consumer source, framework, feed, SDK, runner, restore, Run or Step behavior change.

gates.requiredScope: Complete secure-code and architecture review, STRIDE/CIA/CAPEC evidence, dependency/license/secret checks, SBOM, VEX, SLSA provenance, applicability dispositions and residual-risk ownership for the exact package set.
exactCommands: dotnet list TinyPl0.sln package --vulnerable --include-transitive --source https://api.nuget.org/v3/index.json --format json --output-version 1 > artifacts/security/vulnerabilities.json
dotnet tool run dotnet-CycloneDX src/Pl0.Core/Pl0.Core.csproj -o artifacts/release/sbom/core --output-format Json --spec-version 1.7
dotnet tool run dotnet-CycloneDX src/Pl0.Vm/Pl0.Vm.csproj -o artifacts/release/sbom/vm --output-format Json --spec-version 1.7
gates.rationale: Public packages and OIDC publication create runtime, CI identity and supply-chain trust boundaries that require fail-closed evidence rather than unsupported compliance claims.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any source, dependency, lockfile, package, workflow, permission, action pin, credential path, provider policy, commit, tag, SBOM/VEX finding, attestation or applicability change.

gates.requiredScope: Publish complete German-first/English-second B2 XML and learner guidance, regenerate DocFX, and jointly prove WCAG 2.2 AA, keyboard/text-first use, axe and lynx results with no unresolved serious or critical finding.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command '$server = Start-Process python3 -ArgumentList "-m","http.server","8080","--bind","127.0.0.1","--directory","_site" -PassThru; try { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; lynx -dump -nolist http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/Pl0.Vm.VirtualMachine.html | Select-String -SimpleMatch "VirtualMachine" } finally { Stop-Process -Id $server.Id -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }'
gates.rationale: Changed public APIs and release guidance are incomplete until generated HTML and a linear text path are usable without visual-only meaning.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any public API/XML, package README, host guide, DocFX content/theme/navigation, language order, A11Y test, tool or representative-page change.

gates.requiredScope: For one exact head commit, prove clean delivery set, successful required checks, independent approval, zero unresolved actionable review threads, current authority and valid PreMerge gate evidence; admin bypass cannot replace review.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command 'if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:PR_NUMBER)) { throw "PR_NUMBER is required" }; gh api graphql -f query="query(`$owner:String!,`$name:String!,`$number:Int!){repository(owner:`$owner,name:`$name){pullRequest(number:`$number){headRefOid reviewDecision reviewThreads(first:100){nodes{isResolved isOutdated}}}}}" -F owner=hindermath -F name=TinyPl0 -F number=$env:PR_NUMBER'

pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command 'if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:PREMERGE_EVIDENCE_JSON) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:EXACT_HEAD_SHA)) { throw "PREMERGE_EVIDENCE_JSON and EXACT_HEAD_SHA are required" }; & .specify/presets/autonomous-run-governance/scripts/validate-autonomous-gate-evidence.ps1 -Requirements specs/006-embeddable-vm-nuget/gate-requirements.json -Evidence $env:PREMERGE_EVIDENCE_JSON -Head $env:EXACT_HEAD_SHA'
gates.rationale: Remote checks, human review, authority and evidence must refer to the same immutable commit before any merge or provider action.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any head commit, force-push, check, review, thread, delivery-set, authority, provider-policy or gate-evidence change.

gates.requiredScope: Verify the narrow OIDC policy and immutable action pins, classify both public IDs before and after each push, publish one attested artifact set without skip-duplicate, fail closed on partial/conflict/unknown/409, and prove both public hashes and clean restores.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command 'if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:RELEASE_RUN_ID)) { throw "RELEASE_RUN_ID is required" }; gh run view $env:RELEASE_RUN_ID --json databaseId,headSha,headBranch,event,status,conclusion,jobs,url'
gates.rationale: NuGet has immutable versions but no atomic two-package publish, so success requires narrow identity, the same attested bytes and explicit public-state reconciliation.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any owner/repository/workflow/environment/package policy, action SHA, permission, version, tag, commit, artifact hash, provider response, push result, 409, public package or restore change.

gates.requiredScope: After complete feature review and PreMerge evidence, merge and synchronize main; then complete the causal release PR, public package proof, byte-identical intake archive, lineage, PostMerge evidence and stop without starting a follow-up feature.
exactCommands: pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -Command 'if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:POSTMERGE_EVIDENCE_JSON) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:EXACT_HEAD_SHA) -or [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($env:MERGE_COMMIT_SHA)) { throw "POSTMERGE_EVIDENCE_JSON, EXACT_HEAD_SHA and MERGE_COMMIT_SHA are required" }; & .specify/presets/autonomous-run-governance/scripts/validate-autonomous-gate-evidence.ps1 -Requirements specs/006-embeddable-vm-nuget/gate-requirements.json -Evidence $env:POSTMERGE_EVIDENCE_JSON -Head $env:EXACT_HEAD_SHA -MergeCommit $env:MERGE_COMMIT_SHA'
gates.rationale: Merge, public delivery, synchronization, intake lifecycle and handoff are distinct causal states; closeout may not infer or pre-record any of them.
gates.reevaluationTrigger: Any merge, publication, public restore, main revision, handoff, statistics, traceability, archive, manifest, receipt, gate-evidence or run-state change.
